description: This file defines Express.js route endpoints for a test automation system, including CRUD operations for test suites, results, webhooks, audit logs, and CI/CD callbacks, with detailed Swagger API documentation annotations.

methods.name: listSuites
methods.description: Handles listing of all test suites, with pagination.

methods.name: createSuite
methods.description: Handles creation of a new test suite.

methods.name: getSuite
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific test suite by ID.

methods.name: updateSuite
methods.description: Updates an existing test suite identified by ID.

methods.name: deleteSuite
methods.description: Deletes a specific test suite by ID.

methods.name: executeSuite
methods.description: Triggers execution of a test suite.

methods.name: listResults
methods.description: Fetches paginated list of test execution results, with optional filtering.

methods.name: getResultLogs
methods.description: Retrieves logs for a specific test execution.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Provides access to a specific test report.

methods.name: registerWebhook
methods.description: Registers a new webhook for notifications.
